context: Two friends discuss tighter household budgets during a recession
purpose: Teach: たんぱく/物価/不景気/危険性/ハンドル/急速/細かい/アクセス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、最近の物価、本当にきついよね。スーパー行くたびにため息出ちゃう。
lines.en: Hey, prices lately are really tough, right? Every time I go to the supermarket I sigh.
lines.style: Soft sighing tone, weary but warm, female young adult, intimate friendly register

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わかる。この不景気がいつまで続くのか、ちょっと考えるのも怖いくらい。
lines.en: I get it. Honestly it's almost scary to think how long this recession will last.
lines.style: Calm cafe-worker voice, thoughtful concern, female young adult, gentle steady delivery

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うちは食費を細かいところまで見直してるよ。卵とか豆腐とか、安いたんぱく質ばっかり買ってる。
lines.en: We're reviewing our food budget down to the small details. Just buying cheap protein like eggs and tofu.
lines.style: Practical sharing tone, slight pride in effort, female young adult, conversational pace

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 賢いね。私も家計簿アプリにアクセスして、毎週ちゃんと確認してるんだ。
lines.en: Smart. I also log into my budget app and check it properly every week.
lines.style: Impressed warm response, mild self-disclosure, female young adult, light upbeat tone

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えらい。私なんてつい衝動買いしちゃうから、貯金が急速に減っていく危険性があるんだよね。
lines.en: Impressive. I tend to impulse buy, so my savings are at real risk of dropping fast.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh, embarrassed admission, female young adult, candid friendly tone

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 気持ちはわかるよ。でもさ、車のハンドルと同じで、自分でしっかり握らないと危ないって。
lines.en: I totally get the feeling. But it's like a car's steering wheel — if you don't hold it firmly yourself, it's dangerous.
lines.style: Gentle advising tone, caring older-sister vibe, female young adult, measured supportive delivery

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほんとだよね。今度一緒に節約レシピ考えようよ。アオイのアイデア、いつも助かる。
lines.en: You're so right. Let's brainstorm budget recipes together sometime. Your ideas always save me.
lines.style: Brightening hopeful tone, affectionate appreciation, female young adult, warm closing energy
